mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% year-over-year signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 increases by more than 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a strong consumer demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% MoM
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with an increase in consumer price index signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to increased costs and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases & PAYEMS increases > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases by more than 100,000 in a month.
